description: This file defines API routes related to authentication, including login and registration endpoints, using FastAPI framework. It handles user/admin login, token generation, and user/admin registration with validation.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router object for defining route groups, with prefix '/api/v1/auth' and tag 'Authentication'.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Pydantic schema representing JWT token response.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Pydantic schema for registration data payload.

classes.name: BaseResponse
classes.description: Common response schema indicating success or failure.

classes.name: Admin
classes.description: Database model representing an admin user.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a standard user.

methods.name: login( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user/admin login, verifies credentials, and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: register( request: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Registers a new user or admin, ensures no duplicates, hashes password, and adds to database.

ctags.name: login
ctags.signature: ( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
